item.title: Ofgem expected to raise price cap by 26%, adding £443 to average bill
item.body: Ofgem is predicted to raise the energy price cap by 26% from January. Analysts expect the average annual household energy bill to rise by £443 from the start of 2027.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚡ Ofgem expected to raise price cap by 26%, adding £443 to average bill

Ofgem is predicted to raise the energy price cap by 26% from January. Analysts expect the average annual household energy bill to rise by £443 from the start of 2027.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 16:21
